howto.name: Upload an audio file
howto.text: Drop MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, OGG, or M4A — up to 200 MB.

howto.name: Set start and end
howto.text: Type the start and end timestamps in HH:MM:SS format (e.g. 00:01:30 to 00:02:45).

howto.name: Click Trim audio
howto.text: Stream-copy preserves the original quality — no re-encoding.

faq.q: How precise are the start/end times?
faq.a: To 1-second precision via stream-copy. For frame-accurate trimming, use the Trim Media tool which re-encodes.
No — we use stream-copy mode which preserves the original bytes. The trimmed file is identical quality to the source.
Same format as input. Trim an MP3 → get an MP3. Trim a FLAC → get a FLAC. No re-encoding.
